# NEXIFYWEBTECH

> We Build Digital Experiences.

NEXIFYWEBTECH is an India-based IT Solutions & Software Development Company with 4+ years of experience serving individuals, startups, businesses, and organizations worldwide through remote delivery.

## Verified Track Record
- **Experience**: 4+ Years in Software & IT Solutions
- **Android Apps Built**: 20+ custom Android applications
- **Windows Apps Built**: 10+ Windows desktop software solutions
- **Websites & Web Apps Built**: 50+ responsive websites and web applications

## Proprietary Developed Projects & Portfolio
- **Store POS – Retail Management Software**: Desktop point-of-sale system for retail stores with inventory, barcode scanning, thermal receipt printing, and profit/loss reports.
- **Medical POS – Pharmacy Management Software**: Pharmacy management software with medicine batch numbers, expiry tracking, prescription billing, and supplier records.
- **Hotel POS – Restaurant Management Software**: Restaurant and hotel POS system featuring visual table management, kitchen order tickets (KOT), and multi-counter billing.
- **Library Management System**: Digital cataloging, member registration, book issuing, returning, and fine tracking software.
- **Classes Management System**: Educational coaching management system for student admissions, batch scheduling, attendance, and fee installments.
- **Hisab Software – Accounting & Transaction Management**: Digital business ledger, cashbook, customer/supplier accounts, and debit/credit tracking.
- **Expense Management Software**: Personal and business expense tracking application with monthly summaries and category analytics.
- **WorkKhata – Business Record Management App**: Mobile Android app for customer ledgers, daily transactions, and instant WhatsApp receipt sharing.
- **HaazriPro – Attendance & Wage Management App**: Mobile Android app for contractor workforce attendance, daily wages, half-days, overtime, and monthly salary slips.
- **Homeopathy Clinic Management System**: Web platform for patient records, digital prescriptions, consultation history, and clinic administration.
- **PDFLove – Online PDF Tools Platform**: Free browser-based online PDF document utility platform (https://www.pdflove.store/) for merging, splitting, compressing, and converting PDF files.
- **NEXIFYWEBTECH Official Website**: Official corporate web presence engineered with a premium Glassmorphism design system.
